items.title: Henry A. "Hank" Kmen Interview, 1963-02-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...I believe this was Bob Crosby. [INTERVIEWEE] The big band? The big band. The big band.

ctx.x: Who made the record of Wolverine Blues ever so flippin' with him? I don't recall. I can't remember that, about that time. Maybe that was Eddie Miller's number, but I still think some others. No, it doesn't ring the bell with me. No, there were some others too. Where he plays clarinet, I don't know. Some of the Mound City Blue Blowers, which were really kind of- I believe this was Bob Crosby.
The big band? The big band. The big band.
